entries.title: Frontier Model Forum
entries.last_summary: Leading AI labs have formed a new industry body, the Frontier Model Forum, to develop safety standards and best practices for frontier AI models. The move follows research highlighting a lack of documented containment plans for rogue AI behavior.

entries.title: How agents are transforming work
entries.last_summary: Recent research from OpenAI explores the evolution of AI agents, demonstrating their capacity to handle increasingly complex, multi-step tasks in professional environments. Similar trends are being observed across diverse business sectors and public administration.
